article.title: The Hidden Bet in CVC’s $9.3bn Secondaries Raise
article.body_preview: No secondaries manager has ever returned a fund of this size to its limited partners. CVC Capital Partners is getting closer to finding out whether it can. The firm has raised $9.3 billion for its sixth secondaries vehicle and expects to seal the final close in the third quarter, according to its half-year 2026 results.
